blogPosts.title: Why every small business needs a simple website
blogPosts.excerpt: A clear website builds trust, saves phone time, and helps customers find your services faster — even before you spend on ads.
blogPosts.content:
Many shops still depend only on WhatsApp. That works, but customers often search Google first.

A simple website helps you:
• Show services and prices clearly
• Collect enquiries 24/7
• Look more professional than competitors
• Share one link on visiting cards and Instagram

You do not need a huge site. Start with Home, Services, Work, and Contact. Then grow.

If you want help, Ebenezer Digital can build a clean business site and connect your own domain.
blogPosts.author: Ebenezer Digital

blogPosts.title: Online shop + counter billing: one system is better
blogPosts.excerpt: If you sell online and also in a physical shop, keep stock and billing in one place so numbers stay correct.
blogPosts.content:
Many traders use one notebook for shop bills and a separate website for online orders. That creates stock mistakes.

A better way:
• One product list
• Online shop for customers
• POS billing for counter sales
• Stock reduces automatically

This is what we built for Sri Krishna Mobiles — shop website + POS together.

If your business has both online and offline sales, ask us for a similar setup.
blogPosts.author: Ebenezer Digital

blogPosts.title: Travel websites that get more enquiries
blogPosts.excerpt: Package pages, clear photos, and a simple enquire form convert better than only Instagram posts.
blogPosts.content:
Travel businesses get many WhatsApp questions: price, dates, hotel, inclusions.

A good travel website should:
• Show packages clearly
• Use strong destination photos
• Offer a short enquire form
• Work well on mobile

For Canaan Travel Hub we focused on premium look + easy enquiry.

If you run tours or travel support, a focused travel site can bring warmer leads every week.
blogPosts.author: Ebenezer Digital

blogPosts.title: How to choose a domain for your business
blogPosts.excerpt: Use .com for your main brand. Extra domains like .info, .store, and .net can support blog, products, and client tools.
blogPosts.content:
Your main domain should be easy to say and remember. For most businesses, .com is best.

Extra domains can help:
• .info → blog and tips
• .store → digital products
• .net → client portal / tools later

Do not build four different companies. Keep one brand and connect the extra domains with a clear purpose.

Ebenezer Digital uses ebenezerdigital.com as the main site and .info for the blog.
